text: BNU will offer “English-Taught Credit Course Program” in 78 courses, hoping to enroll overseas students. All the courses are designed for students who not only possess a high professional proficiency but are also familiar with Chinese society and culture. Study Duration and Study Mode Students should choose three to five courses among below 61 courses for one semester. After you finish the course, you will get the credit and could use it at your own country study. You could download the detail information of the courses here: Introduction to English-Taught Credit-Course Program
